description: Implement a comprehensive code quality improvement system that includes linting, formatting, and simplification tools. The system should automatically identify and fix common code issues while providing a simple interface for developers to run all quality checks.
functional_requirements: Add a linting tool configuration that automatically checks for spelling errors, code simplifications, and style issues
Implement automated code formatting that ensures all Go code follows standard formatting conventions
Create a Makefile with simple commands to run linting, formatting, and other code quality checks
Apply the linting and formatting tools to existing codebase files to fix identified issues
